user.title: Set up a Smarther thermostat
user.description: The MQTT bridge is a one-time prerequisite. [First-time setup guide]({setup_guide_url}). Enter only the name and device topic prefix; never paste vendor credentials here. Setup does not send thermostat commands.

data_description.topic_prefix: Prefix ending before /device_state. Do not include the /device_state or /set suffix.

error.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the Home Assistant MQTT integration first.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a valid, exact MQTT prefix without + or #.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic prefix is already configured.

init.title: Controls and dashboard
init.description: Allow commands only after verifying the remote bridge, recent telemetry and absence of competing command writers. Dashboard tools are separate: they make this thermostat selectable in the guided builder, without creating dashboards or enabling commands.

data.enable_dashboard: Make this thermostat available to create a Smarther dashboard

data_description.enable_dashboard: Off by default. Creation requires your action in Home Assistant Dashboards. Turning this off leaves existing dashboards unchanged.

dashboard.title: Create a Smarther dashboard
dashboard.description:
Select Submit to save this option, then follow the [dashboard guide]({dashboard_guide_url}).

1. In [Resources]({resources_url}), add `{resource_url}` once as a **JavaScript module**. Reuse the resource if it is already listed.
2. Reload the page, open [Dashboards]({dashboards_url}), choose **Add dashboard → Community dashboards → Smarther**, and select this thermostat.
3. Choose a name, URL and sidebar visibility. Open the new dashboard; use **Take control** to edit its layout.

Options do not create or update dashboards. Reuse an existing dashboard to avoid copies. The guide also includes a native-card fallback when the resource is unavailable. This process sends no thermostat commands.
